title: Letter to Moses Nickerson, 19 November 1833
source_note: JS, Letter, Kirtland Mills, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to Moses Nickerson, Mount Pleasant, Brantford Township, Wentworth Co., Gore District, Upper Canada, 19 Nov. 1833. Retained copy, [ca. 19 Nov. 1833], in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 62–65; handwriting of Oliver Cowdery; JS Collection, CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
